title: Experimental-data-driven thermal conductivity prediction and inverse composition design for alloys
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,28943-28951
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01983H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Anh D. Phan, Vu Bich Hanh, Ngo T. Que, Nguyen T. T. Duyen, Do T. Nga, Baicheng Mei
We collect the largest experimental dataset for alloy thermal conductivity and accurately predict the property from composition and temperature. We can inversely design to find target-matching alloys and composition-tolerant windows for synthesis.
